name: CVF Engineering Spec-Driven Development
owner: CVF ASSF registry and work-order governance surface
purpose: Guide future governed engineering changes from specification evidence into bounded work-order execution, without bypassing source verification, scope, or closure gates.
useWhen: A governed engineering task needs a source-backed specification, bounded implementation plan, expected receipts, and acceptance evidence before edits begin.
doNotUseWhen: The task is a direct answer, a pure review with no implementation plan, a runtime activation claim, or a change already governed by a more specific CVF work order.
executionConstraints: metadata-only candidate; does not authorize code edits, commits, runtime behavior, or provider calls by itself
acceptanceEvidence: future promotion requires package instance evidence, UAT or reviewer proof, and current CVF gates; AGSK-T7 only creates metadata
authorityCeiling: metadata-only advisory selection; loading this entry cannot authorize implementation beyond the active work order
sideEffects: none from metadata loading; future selected package may guide documentation or planning only after separate authorization
permissions: read metadata and cited governed source artifacts only
rollback: delete this registry entry and regenerate the skill index if reviewer rejects AGSK-T7
safeStop: if spec, source verification, or acceptance evidence is missing, stop and require a source-verified work order
capabilityBoundary: no package body, no SKILL.md, no runtime activation, no checker wiring, no commit authority, no provider/live proof
resolverBehavior: metadata-only; resolver returns identity and selector fields; does not open any SKILL.md or instruction body
loaderBoundary: loading this metadata never grants authority to edit files, commit, activate a package, or bypass work-order gates
adapterContract: N/A with reason: external CLI/MCP adapter not authored in AGSK-T7
adapterEvidence: N/A with reason: no adapter implemented in AGSK-T7
externalMutationBoundary: no external mutation permitted until a separate ASSF adapter work order is accepted
shellAssumptions: no shell execution required for metadata-only candidate
